# Portfolix v0.1.15
## 更新内容
- 升级「AI 投研」体验与 Agent 架构：支持多会话线程管理、本地投研记忆、投顾角色定制、交错式工具调用与时间线进度展示、自适应输入框，以及 Antigravity MCP 集成；修复无 Key 状态提示与模型输出解析边界问题。 - 重构「风险画像」单页风控护栏工作台：升级为 6 项核心风控护栏与三档风险状态，支持草稿编辑、未保存导航拦截与备份往返还原。 - 新增只读「演示模式」（设置 → 数据管理）：一键载入 30 天多币种模拟组合与预置投资分布，支持安全体验完整功能而不影响个人账本。 - 统一视觉与双语语义体系：采用黑曜紫晶（Obsidian Amethyst）深浅色配色方案，统一弹窗与主窗口玻璃材质、AI 头像与侧边栏图标品牌渐变、全应用文案规范，并将投资云图「今日盈亏」面积改为按当日盈亏绝对值加权。 - 优化首日账本体验与数据一致性：新账本首日完整展示盈亏日历网格与投资分布回退，修正同日余额校准时的今日盈亏计算一致性、人民币基准账本币种换算，以及后台自动更新注册失败时的状态回滚与中文错误提示。 - 完善持仓操作、交易表单与双语本地化细节：包括未选中持仓时的按钮禁用态、清零持仓二次确认、持仓搜索空状态、交易单价精度与候选列表交互优化、现金账户动态双语命名与精确时间戳展示。
## What's New
- Upgraded the AI Research Agent with multi-thread conversations, local research memory, advisor persona customization, interleaved tool calls with timeline progress, an adaptive composer, and Antigravity MCP integration, alongside missing-key and response-parsing fixes. - Redesigned Risk Profile into a single-page guardrail workspace featuring 6 core guardrails, 3-tier severity states, draft/save workflows with unsaved-change protection, and full backup round-trip support. - Added a read-only 30-day Demo Mode (Settings → Data Management) with a realistic multi-currency portfolio and built-in investment distribution so you can explore the full app without affecting your personal ledger. - Unified the visual and bilingual copy system around the Obsidian Amethyst light/dark palette, consistent glass materials across sheets and windows, matching brand gradients for AI avatars and the sidebar icon, refined terminology, and daily P&L Investment Cloud weighting by absolute P&L amount. - Improved first-day dashboard usability and ledger consistency, including full P&L calendar grids on day one, Investment Map auto-fallback, consistent daily P&L handling alongside same-day reconciliations, CNY base-currency accounting fixes, and reliable background price updater rollback with localized errors. - Refined holdings actions, trade forms, and localization details: disabled states when no position is selected, zero-quantity clear confirmation, position search empty states, improved trade unit-price precision and candidate-list scrolling, dynamic bilingual cash account names, and unified trade timestamps.
Build 28 · Apple Silicon · macOS 15+

# Portfolix v0.1.14
## 更新内容
- 全面升级资产总览与视觉体系：采用统一的语义字号与淡彩资产大类配色，优化深浅色模式下的图表可读性、提示框样式与侧边栏选中指示。 - 资产总览卡片体验焕新：组合价值卡展示已实现收益、现金合计与近 30 天走势；新增「收益波动」双区浮盈与回撤图、「投资云图」双模式市场地图，以及支持自然行数自适应与悬停详情的「盈亏日历」；主要持仓列表升级为 5 列自适应布局并支持点击跳转定位。 - 统一弹窗与表单控件的深浅色玻璃材质（含 MCP 配置参考弹窗），并优化浅色/深色模式下智能分析助手消息气泡的辨识度。 - 加固后台行情更新与数据精度：全链路估值与历史快照统一采用高精度 `Decimal`，优化含点号美股代码（如 `BRK.B`）识别、本地时区快照对齐与数据库文件权限。 - 增强智能分析、联网搜索与 MCP 服务的安全性与准确性：统一无持久化网络会话、响应体积与重定向防护，修复未知成本展示、历史完整性校验与追问文本清洗边界问题。 - 修复多项界面与交互细节：包括追问已有草稿时的语音录入刷新、风险问卷重开回填、云图负金额紧凑排版、混合币种成本排序、交易撤销状态校验，以及无障碍与减少动态效果适配。
## What's New
- Upgraded the dashboard and visual system with semantic typography, a refined pale 5-class asset palette, unified tooltip surfaces, and a clearer sidebar selection indicator in both light and dark modes. - Refreshed dashboard cards: Portfolio Value now shows realized profit, cash total, and a 30-day sparkline; added the dual-pane Returns & Drawdown chart, the dual-mode Investment Cloud treemap, an adaptive P&L Calendar with hover summaries, and a responsive 5-column Primary Positions list with click-to-jump navigation. - Unified glass control surfaces across sheets (including the MCP setup sheet) in light and dark modes, and improved AI assistant message bubble visibility. - Hardened background price updates and ledger precision with end-to-end `Decimal` valuation and snapshots, dot share-class US symbol normalization (e.g., `BRK.B`), local-timezone alignment, and stricter database file permissions. - Strengthened AI analysis, web search, and MCP reliability with ephemeral network sessions, redirect and payload limits, accurate unknown-cost and history-completeness handling, and cleaner response sanitization. - Fixed UI and interaction edge cases, including voice dictation updates with existing follow-up drafts, risk questionnaire reopening, compact negative treemap labels, mixed-currency cost sorting, trade reversal validation, and accessibility/Reduce Motion support.
Build 27 · Apple Silicon · macOS 15+

# Portfolix v0.1.13
## 更新内容
- 新账本默认提供 Apple、NVIDIA、BTC 三项示例持仓，可自行编辑或删除；已有账本保持原样。 - 每次完全退出后重新打开 App（包括首次打开），自动刷新一次价格，独立于后台定时刷新策略。 - 新增 Exa、AnySearch 搜索支持，支持多个搜索来源并发调用，改善追问时的搜索主题、引用与次数统计。 - 优化 AI 回答格式解析和引用展示，减少异常内容对阅读的干扰。 - 选择器和侧边栏加入流畅的紫色滑动选中效果，移除侧边栏的灰色悬停背景。 - 无盈亏记录时仍显示完整日历、柱状图坐标和收益趋势零线，并优化首页日期文字与金额显示。
## What's New
- New ledgers start with editable Apple, NVIDIA, and BTC sample holdings. Existing ledgers remain unchanged. - Supported asset prices refresh once on every fresh app launch, including the first launch, independently of background updates. - Added Exa and AnySearch, concurrent search providers, and improved follow-up search relevance, citations, and search statistics. - Improved AI response parsing and citation display for more readable answers. - Added smooth purple selection animations to selectors and the sidebar, and removed the sidebar's gray hover background. - Kept the calendar, bar-chart axes, and return-trend zero line visible without P&L history, and refined dashboard date and amount typography.
Build 26 · Apple Silicon · macOS 15+

# Portfolix v0.1.12 (Build 25)
- 修复 Agent 分析中证据校验误判导致的报错与回退。 - 改善分析自动修复和失败诊断。 - 更新持仓时，自动换算的成本价最多保留 8 位小数。
## What's New
- Fixed incorrect evidence validation causing Agent analysis failures and fallback. - Improved automatic report repair and failure diagnostics. - Limited calculated unit costs in holding updates to 8 decimal places.
Apple Silicon · macOS 15+
